{{Quote|The four of us may not have been enough to launch a successful assault&mdash;but I believe in ''Big Mama''!|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Night Moves!">{{TCWComicCite|6.27|Night Moves!}}</ref>}}
